checks: Synthetic policy, fixed catalog, isolated queue, and controller status exposed over real loopback HTTP.
Version check wrote exactly one immutable request; fixed worker receipt bound by SHA-256 of canonical full request; installed version and install hash verified.
Preview froze source/version/install identity and did not enqueue an update request.
One explicit confirmation produced one execute request; running/poll period did not replay it; nested receipt verified target version, protected configuration, and recovery status.
Reload restored the durable SQLite execution job and receipt without replay.

Standalone selector defaulted to the first manageable machine in inventory; selecting the synthetic 101-bound machine showed the dedicated updater despite missing legacy AI-development profile/policy.
Machine-detail view rendered the shared updater in fixed-target mode without a duplicate target selector.
390px mobile viewport had no horizontal overflow.
A synthetic mismatched requestHash receipt stayed unknown and was not presented as success.
An unattached synthetic machine was blocked and created no queue request.

fixtureBoundary.worker: local fixed synthetic receipt writer; no package download or install

screenshots.disposition: Screenshots and temporary browser data were removed by the harness cleanup before the request to preserve them. No screenshots were reconstructed or fabricated.

limitations: This validates browser behavior, loopback HTTP routes, SQLite persistence, and synthetic queue/receipt handling only.
It does not verify a real 101 host, real installed Claude Code bytes, real release metadata/download, real SSH, or a real update.
